items.title: Emile Barnes Interview, 1962-01-03
items.q: Joe Watkins was Sam Morgan. Well, he was alright but he was good and crazy too.

ctx.x: Could he play with Chris? Would he make it with Chris? Well, yeah. He could play with Chris.

He could play with Chris. He could play with Chris. He could play with Chris. He could play by ear then, huh? He could play by ear. What about Joe Watkins? Joe Watkins. Joe Watkins was Sam Morgan. Well, he was alright but he was good and crazy too.
